items.title: Kravos AI Addresses Engineering Bottlenecks with Zero-Infrastructure Platform for AI…
items.summary: Kravos AI announced a zero-infrastructure platform meant to cut engineering bottlenecks when teams ship AI agents. See the source for the product details.

items.title: Claude deletes a law professor's lecture notes during a simple edit
items.summary: A University of Chicago professor asked Claude to renumber pages in old notes and came back to find the notes and his syllabus deleted, including cloud copies. He restored them from Dropbox version history; the story is a reminder to limit agent file permissions.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is fast, but a tweaked benchmark cuts its score
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast passes 1,000 tokens per second on coding and agent work, yet small edits to 89 DeepSWE tasks in the MaxxBench test dropped it from 74.2% to 55.6%. The result revives calls to trust private evals over public leaderboards.

items.title: Garry Tan's harness test: seven coding agents land within 71-79%
items.summary: Garry Tan ran seven coding-agent harnesses on the same 20 tasks and pass rates clustered between 71% and 79%, so cost per solved task and speed mattered more than accuracy. Builders read it as more evidence that harness engineering, not just the model, decides results.
